content:
{'text': '現有 iPad mini 128GB 基本版本售價為 599 美元。Apple 將於本月底前推出新一代 iPad mini，雖然起始儲存容量可能會增加，但有意入手嘅買家應該開始做好加價嘅心理準備。', 'paragraph_context': 'The current iPad mini sells for $599 in its starting 128 GB configuration. Apple is set to introduce the next-generation iPad mini later this month and — while the starting storage may increase — interested buyers should start probably bracing for a price rise.'}

{'text': 'Bloomberg 嘅 Mark Gurman 表示，佢收到消息指新 iPad mini 將會「貴咗唔少」，新定價可能會接近 799 美元。', 'paragraph_context': 'Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman says he is hearing that the new iPad mini will be “considerably more expensive”, floating a new price closer to the $799 mark.'}

{'text': '如果真係咁，相比現時 iPad mini 嘅起標價，將會貴 200 美元，並且會高過現時產品線入面 11 吋 iPad Air 嘅起標價。', 'paragraph_context': 'If that turned out to be the case, it would represent a $200 jump compared to the current iPad mini baseline, and slot it above the 11-inch iPad Air starting price in the current lineup.'}

{'text': '當然，Apple 會話畀你聽你用呢筆錢買到更多嘢。新 iPad mini 預計會首次採用 OLED 螢幕，並配備全新機身設計，包括更窄嘅邊框。', 'paragraph_context': 'Of course, Apple will argue that you are getting more product for that money. The new iPad mini is expected to feature an OLED display for the first time, with a new chassis design including thinner bezels.'}

{'text': '新 iPad mini 嘅揚聲器亦都會升級，並搭載效能大幅提升嘅晶片。我哋相信佢會採用 A20 Pro 晶片，即係同 Apple 高階 iPhone 18 Pro 系列所用嘅晶片一樣。', 'paragraph_context': 'The new iPad mini is also getting upgraded speaker system and a much more powerful chip upgrade. We believe it will be powered by the A20 Pro chip, the same chip as found in Apple’s high-end iPhone 18 Pro models.'}

{'text': '不過，新 iPad mini 所用嘅 OLED 螢幕喺技術上能否媲美 iPad Pro 嘅業界領先 tandem OLED 面板，目前仍係未知之數。至於會否支援 120Hz ProMotion，各方報導亦都存在矛盾。', 'paragraph_context': 'However, it remains unclear whether the OLED display in the new iPad mini will be technically comparable to the iPad Pro’s industry-leading tandem OLED panel. There have also been conflicting reports about whether it will support 120Hz ProMotion.'}

{'text': '新 iPad mini 預計會喺本月底嘅發布會上同全新 OLED MacBook Pros 一同亮相。不過喺此之前，Apple 將會喺星期二舉辦一場名為「Welcome home」嘅活動，屆時將會公布全新智能家居策略，當中包括首款智能家居顯示產品。', 'paragraph_context': 'The new iPad mini should be announced at a media event later this month, alongside new OLED MacBook Pros. But first, on Tuesday, Apple will host a ‘Welcome home’ event where it will unveil a new smart home strategy, including its first smart home display product.'}
